issues.description: The problem statement gives conflicting instructions about the SealSaloon.stock attribute: one part instructs to make stock a final (instance) field initialized in the constructor, while a later note requires the stock attribute to be static and that related methods be static. Initializing a static field in an instance constructor is not valid, and students will be confused whether stock should be an instance final field (set in constructor) or a static shared field (set at declaration or in a static initializer). The solution implements stock as static final initialized at declaration, which differs from the earlier instruction to initialize it in the constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify and reconcile the specification: either (A) require stock to be an instance (final) field and instruct students to initialize it in the SealSaloon constructor (and do not require static methods), or (B) require stock to be a static (shared) field and specify that it must be initialized at declaration or in a static initializer (and keep calculateTotalPrice and acceptSupplyDelivery static). Update the UML and text consistently to reflect the chosen design so students know where and how to initialize the stock field.

issues.description: The template StockIngredient class defines the quantity accessor as retrieveQuantity(), while the rest of the codebase and the problem statement expect a conventional getter getQuantity(). Stock.java calls getQuantity(), and the solution implementation uses getQuantity(). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (the ingredient quantity getter) creates confusion and leads to compilation errors and difficulty mapping the problem requirement "add getters for all the private fields" to the template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template accessor retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), or alternatively change all callers to use retrieveQuantity(). Prefer renaming to getQuantity() to match the conventional getter naming (and the solution implementation) and to satisfy the problem statement's request to add getters for private fields.
